name: rescue-portal
description: Rescue Portal - centralized emergency healthcare coordination (Rescue side)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,hospital -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @rescue/api" "npm run dev -w @rescue/web" "npm run dev:hospital"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @rescue/api && npm run build -w @rescue/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @rescue/api && npm run test -w @rescue/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @rescue/api && npm run lint -w @rescue/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @rescue/api && npm run typecheck -w @rescue/web
